source_of_truth.active_host_inventory: Supabase public.bigo_sources returned by the BIGO live pipeline source-registry endpoint
source_of_truth.merge_policy: Deduplicate the union of active registry host IDs, BIGO_HOST_IDS, and BIGO_VERIFIED_HOST_IDS; retain registry source URLs where present and use https://www.bigo.tv/{host_id} only as a URL fallback.
source_of_truth.allowlist_semantics: BIGO_VERIFIED_HOST_IDS is included in the capture inventory; it does not replace active source-registry checks or per-host rights evidence.

capture_method_observed.method: Resolve room metadata using BIGO webjs token flow and attempt Streamlink capture; normalize/process media; upload to Dropbox and read back to verify content hash; R2/Drive are secondary providers.

session_cookie.behavior_when_absent: Warn only; proceed with the existing tokenized capture flow. Do not fail the whole workflow solely because BIGO_SESSION_COOKIE is absent.

capture_method_observed.credential_storage: Keep Dropbox OAuth credentials and any optional BIGO session cookie in GitHub Actions encrypted secrets; never store their values in Dropbox manifests or this config.

capture_status_policy.archive_verified: Dropbox upload and read-back content hash match verified
capture_status_policy.captured_not_published: Media archived but downstream publishing not confirmed
capture_status_policy.published_verified: Downstream platform returns a publication identifier or URL and the post is read back/verified
capture_status_policy.failed_or_offline: Record per-host outcome and continue processing other hosts
